student.title: You
student.subtitle: Executive Producer and Creative Director
student.primer: You set the vision, priorities, scope, and quality bar. You resolve conflicting recommendations and accept the work. Agents recommend; you decide, and you stay accountable for every GDF deliverable.

ideation.does: Choose the experience and player motivation; pick one concept from several.
expects: two or three concept options, each with an X
rough time and cost estimate per concept
delivers: limits on your own weekly time

expects: Initial Project Plan and Risk Register
delivers: G1 recording, X, Risk Profile, Initial GDD, and Configuration Document
G1.recommends: The concept and commitments put before the instructor.

prototype.does: Watch the playtest; decide what each finding means for the concept.
prototype.recommends: Whether a finding changes the concept or only the build.

G2.does: Present the first playable and what players did with it.
G2.recommends: What you claim the prototype shows.

planning.does: Reconcile competing estimates; set scope and exclusions.
delivers: approved priorities, exclusions, and fallback triggers
planning.recommends: What stays in, what is cut, and each fallback trigger.

delivers: scope-lock plan, exclusions, updated Risk Register
G3.recommends: The scope you propose for approval.

production.does: Review builds against the plan; triage with QA.
delivers: change request, if scope must move
production.recommends: Which defects block release and which you accept.

G4.does: Accept the release candidate and disclose open issues.
delivers: Gold candidate, recording, Final GDD, and Configuration Document
G4.recommends: Accept the release; list the accepted defects.

release.does: Showcase the game, play three classmates' builds, and draft the AAR.
release.recommends: What the project taught, in your own account.

G5.does: Account for the whole team and the decisions you kept.
delivers: final game, AAR, Final Playtest Log, archive
G5.recommends: Whether the archive is complete enough to close.

instructor.title: Instructor
instructor.subtitle: Gate Approver
instructor.primer: The instructor approves each gate or places it on Hold with corrective work. Braintrust feedback from classmates informs the decision; it does not make it.

ideation.does: Ran the first pitch round on Nov 9.

delivers: decision and conditions as a CourseWorks comment
G1.recommends: Approve or Hold the prototype investigation.

prototype.does: Office hours; Session 10 working session on Nov 23.
delivers: checkpoint feedback on the deployed model call

G2.does: Review the first playable and playtest evidence.
delivers: decision in the repository's Gate decisions issue
decision in the repository's Gate decisions issue
G3.recommends: Approve or Hold production against the scope.

expects: change request with cause and impact

delivers: Gold decision in the repository's Gate decisions issue
G4.recommends: Approve Gold for the identified build.

release.does: Read AAR drafts; approve any corrective release.
